title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Woosnam's 2001 Open Penalty
items.text: Ian Woosnam received a two-stroke penalty at the 2001 Open for carrying 15 clubs, which turned his opening birdie into a bogey and left him four shots behind leader David Duval.

items.headline: LIV Golf Funding Fallout
items.text: If LIV Golf funding ends after 2026, players like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm must be released from LIV contracts and apply for PGA Tour reinstatement under tough terms like Brooks Koepka's.

items.headline: Jackson Koivun's Comeback
items.text: After winning the 3M Open, Jackson Koivun rallied from outside the cut line at the Rocket Classic with a second-round 67 to make the weekend and bolster his rising superstar status.
